## Wireframe: Mobile Login Screen

### Layout Structure

```
┌─────────────────────────┐
│      [App Logo]        │
│                         │
│     Welcome Back       │
│   Sign in to continue  │
│                         │
│  ┌─────────────────┐  │
│  │  Email          │  │
│  └─────────────────┘  │
│                         │
│  ┌─────────────────┐  │
│  │  Password  👁  │  │
│  └─────────────────┘  │
│                         │
│   [Forgot Password?]   │
│                         │
│  ┌─────────────────┐  │
│  │   Sign In       │  │
│  └─────────────────┘  │
│                         │
│  ──────── OR ────────  │
│                         │
│  [Google]  [Apple]    │
│                         │
│  Don't have an account │
│  [Sign Up]            │
└─────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Component Details

| Element | Type | Behavior |
|---------|------|----------|
| Logo | Image | Centered, 48x48 |
| Title | Text | H1, bold, 24px |
| Subtitle | Text | Body, 16px, gray |
| Email Input | Text field | Keyboard: email, validation |
| Password Input | Text field | Toggle visibility, forgot link |
| Sign In Button | Primary CTA | Full width, 48px height |
| Social Buttons | Secondary | 40px height, icons |
| Sign Up Link | Text link | Blue, tappable |

---

### Spacing (8pt Grid)

- Logo to title: 32px
- Title to subtitle: 8px
- Subtitle to email: 24px
- Input to input: 16px
- Input to button: 24px
- Button to divider: 24px
- Divider to social: 16px

---

### Edge Cases

- Empty fields: Show "Required" error
- Invalid email: Show format error
- Wrong password: Show inline error
- Loading: Disable button, show spinner
- Keyboard: Scroll content above keyboard
